nodes.label: MRI as a Primary Input With Symptoms as Context
nodes.rationale: The documents, not the interface, were stale: the MRI direction is deliberate product intent, so this ADR is the deliberate revision that lifts the V1 exclusion. A visit becomes scan + symptoms + chief complaint at a point in time, consumed by one analysis. Replacing the symptom pipeline would discard a tested backend and the literature-citation differentiator to save UI work.

nodes.label: Scan Attaches to a Visit, Not a Patient
nodes.rationale: Cross-visit scan comparison then costs nothing structurally because detect_trends already consumes per-visit data and visit ownership rules already exist. The USP is a trajectory, and a trajectory needs more than one point; one current scan per patient removes the second data point early detection requires.

nodes.label: Stage Estimate as Top-Ranked Candidate, Never a Lone Verdict
nodes.rationale: A stage label is a conclusion; a ranked differential with contradicting findings is decision support. Output stays a ranked list with likelihood bands, supporting and contradicting findings, and citations. CN / MCI / Mild / Moderate / Severe may appear as the highest-ranked candidate but not as a single headline answer with a certainty figure, and the word 'certainty' does not appear in UI copy.

nodes.label: Staging Model Behind Its Own Provider Seam
nodes.rationale: A third seam alongside the retriever and the reasoning client, following the pattern that has now worked twice: schema-real, provider-mocked, deterministic, labelled as simulated. Because provenance is now three-dimensional (simulated retrieval, live reasoning, simulated staging), AI_PROVIDER as a single literal no longer stretches and staging needs its own setting.

nodes.label: Scan File Retained Outside the Database
nodes.rationale: A PDF can be regenerated from its snapshot; a scan cannot. The bytes live in file or object storage with a reference, dimensions and a checksum in the database, keeping ADR-004's no-binary-column rule while accepting that imaging is source data rather than a derived artifact. A storage backend therefore becomes a deployment dependency.

nodes.label: Clinician Sign-Off Gates the Report
nodes.rationale: No PDF is produced until a clinician has accepted or amended the analysis, and the report records who signed and when. This makes the safety boundary structural rather than a disclaimer: if an unreviewed AI document can be printed and circulated, the review step is decoration. Adds reviewer identity and timestamp state plus a gate on the PDF endpoint; ADR-004's render-before-persist behaviour is unchanged.

nodes.label: Dashboard Is a Ranked Triage Queue
nodes.rationale: Ordered by open early_watch flags, then worsening trends, then analyses awaiting sign-off. No stat tiles: the queue is itself the answer to 'what needs attention', an aggregate confidence average across patients is clinically meaningless and a step back toward the framing FR-04 warns about, and every tile on the audited dashboard was derived from a hardcoded array. A triage query across all of a clinician's patients cannot be assembled from the existing per-patient routes.

nodes.label: Intake Splits Into New Patient and New Visit
nodes.rationale: Patient creation takes demographics only, matching the real PatientCreate contract; visit creation takes scan, symptoms and complaint. The previous single combined form could not express 'an existing patient returns for a follow-up scan', which is the only case that produces a trend. The current upload page posts multipart/form-data with mri_scan, mmse_score and family_history to POST /patients, which accepts PatientCreate JSON, so it cannot ever have worked and must be rebuilt rather than adapted.

nodes.label: Provenance Stated per Analysis, Not per Environment
nodes.rationale: Each analysis carries a line derived from pipeline_note describing what was real and what was simulated, travelling into the PDF, so a screenshot of a result cannot be mistaken for validated clinical output. A persistent environment-level demo banner was rejected because it says nothing about which parts of a specific result were simulated. A staging UI backed by a mocked model is more convincing than a mocked text pipeline, because a brain region with a percentage looks like measurement, so this mitigation is not optional.

nodes.label: detect_trends Must Be Extended for Scan Metrics
nodes.rationale: It reads symptom severities today; unless scan-derived metrics feed it, the trend story stays symptom-only and the scan contributes nothing to early_watch.

nodes.label: Clinical Safety Boundary (NeuroONE assists, never autonomously diagnoses)
nodes.rationale: Not negotiable and not revised by this ADR. FR-04's prohibition on definitive-diagnosis framing continues to apply to the stage estimate, reaching schema, API field naming, UI copy and the PDF. Uploaded diagnostic-report analysis, autonomous diagnosis and automated treatment decisions remain hard exclusions; admitting MRI is not a precedent for admitting the others.

nodes.label: Two Signals Can Disagree
nodes.rationale: Symptoms may point one way and the scan another. Making them one analysis surfaces disagreement as contradicting findings on a candidate rather than two competing verdicts; two independent analyses side by side were rejected because arbitration is the clinical work and handing it over unstructured is worse than one analysis that shows its tensions.
